front.title: Sovereign Tensor Container (STC) and Provenance (STP) Specifications

abstract.t: This document defines the Sovereign Tensor Container (STC-1.0) and Sovereign Tensor Provenance (STP-1.0) specifications. STC-1.0 establishes a strict 64-byte physical memory alignment standard for binary machine learning tensor payloads to enable zero-copy Direct Memory Access (DMA). STP-1.0 defines an embedded cryptographic provenance framework utilizing C2PA profiles, X.509 signature chains, and SCITT-compatible attestations to secure supply-chain integrity for distributed AI models.
